title: Custom Promotional Socks Manufacturer
description: Custom promotional and logo socks for corporate gifts, events and merchandise. Work with Huakui on artwork, samples and packaging in Foshan, China.
intro: For a campaign, company gift or event, a good custom sock needs to carry the brand clearly and still feel worth wearing. Huakui helps buyers turn an idea, logo or campaign brief into a practical, retail-ready sock programme.
galleryLabel: Corporate, promotional and event sock example

highlights.heading: Built around the occasion
highlights.text: Develop socks for corporate gifts, exhibitions, launches, employee programmes and branded merchandise, with the construction matched to the intended use.

highlights.heading: Custom Logo Socks: Artwork and Knitted Patterns
highlights.text: Plan logo placement, colour matching, jacquard patterns and finished details so the sock remains recognisably yours.

highlights.heading: Packing ready for distribution
highlights.text: Coordinate individual sleeves, sets, cards or gift-ready packaging alongside the product, rather than treating packaging as an afterthought.

title: Custom Jacquard & Novelty Socks Manufacturer
description: Develop custom jacquard and novelty socks with Huakui in China. Plan knitted patterns, colours, samples and private label packaging for your collection.
intro: Lifestyle socks are often bought for their character: a colour story, pattern, illustration or small branded detail. Huakui gives brands a structured route from design reference to sample, approved specification and repeat production.
galleryLabel: Jacquard, novelty and lifestyle sock example

highlights.heading: Patterns that translate into knitting
highlights.text: Start with artwork, a mood board or a reference sample. We help establish knit-friendly pattern placement, colour direction and construction.

highlights.heading: More than a novelty item
highlights.text: Balance visual impact with everyday comfort, fit and finish so a seasonal concept can become a credible product line.

highlights.heading: Private label from product to pack
highlights.text: Align socks, branding details and packaging to create a coherent retail presentation—and retain approved references for reorders.

title: Sports Socks Manufacturer for Brands and Teams
description: Source custom sports and team socks from Huakui in China. Discuss crew lengths, cushioning, logo details, samples and private label packaging.
intro: Sport and team socks need to work in use—not only on a product board. Starting with the wearer, activity, height and expected performance gives the development process a clear direction from the first sample.
galleryLabel: Sport, team and everyday sock example

highlights.heading: Custom Crew Socks, Ankle Socks and Team Lengths
highlights.text: From no-show and ankle socks to crew, mid-calf and knee-high styles, select a length and size range that fits the activity and wearer.

highlights.heading: Running, Hiking and Cycling Sock Briefs
highlights.text: Tell us whether your programme is for running, hiking, cycling or everyday team wear. Define shoe fit, sock height, cushioning zones, yarn composition and any test requirements so feasibility can be reviewed before sampling.

highlights.heading: A clear route to repeat orders
highlights.text: Keep approved samples, size specifications and packaging references connected to bulk production for more consistent seasonal and replenishment orders.
